name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Romulus MI

fieldNotes.facilityId: Confirmed as the 135,000 sq ft Kroger/Ocado CFC at 15675 Wahrman Rd (the COMPACT west building with the tall automated 'hive' roof and 250-stall employee lot), NOT the much larger separate Kroger/Penske distribution building (~16005 Wahrman) immediately to the east, which is a different property.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled internal truck gate: a small guard booth sits inside a fenced island at the mouth of the south dock yard (approx 42.18758,-83.38137), pinching the truck path between the south perimeter/drop lot and the dock apron.
fieldNotes.guardShack: ~1-2 vehicle-footprint white booth in the fenced island with a vehicle parked beside it; classic staffed gatehouse, not the main building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide multi-lane entrance apron off Wahrman Rd and a large open paved yard give ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South face shows roughly 8-10 dock positions with several trailers backed in; small automated CFC ships heavily via vans/box trucks, so dock count is modest.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked without tractors along the south perimeter strip; counted ~16 trailers, capacity ~24 -> band 10-25 (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane at the booth; exit single lane. Lane count inferred from imagery, not certain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park near Detroit Metro Airport, bordered by woods/open land; per rubric (when torn choose Rural) classified Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main CFC plus one small attached/adjacent annex building on the north side = 2; the large DC to the east is excluded as a separate property.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.

citations.claim: Kroger plans to EXPAND the capacity of its Detroit (Romulus) CFC; Michigan CFC among retained sites.
Kroger/Ocado high-tech CFC at 15675 Wahrman Rd, Romulus MI; serves greater Detroit.

verification.rationale: Romulus/Detroit MI is a real Kroger/Ocado CFC at 15675 Wahrman Rd; Kroger is EXPANDING it, not closing.
